description: The file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety.csv' is already open in Jamovi. This dataset is from a study (Field, 2013) examining predictors of exam performance. Variables: 'Code' (participant ID), 'Revise' (hours spent revising), 'Exam' (exam score %), 'Anxiety' (exam anxiety score), 'Gender'. Click 'Regression' in the top menu bar and select 'Linear Regression'. Move 'Exam' to the 'Dependent Variable' box. Move both 'Revise' and 'Anxiety' to the 'Covariates' box. Under 'Model Coefficients', enable 'Standardized estimate' (β) and 'Confidence interval'. Under 'Model Fit', ensure 'R', 'R²', and 'F test' are enabled.
